description: South Korea average wage (pyeonggyun imgeum): daily average over the 3 months before the last working day, the basis for severance pay and unemployment benefit; falls back to the ordinary wage when that is higher.

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

annualLeavePay.description: Annual-leave allowance paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage (base pay + fixed allowances). If its daily amount (÷209×8) exceeds the daily average wage, severance is computed from it (KRW)

monthlyPay.description: Monthly pay over the last 3 months (KRW)

name: average_wage
